headline: Herzog picks Eisenkot to form Israel's next government'
dek: [VERIFIED FACT] President Isaac Herzog has chosen Gadi Eisenkot, leader of the Yashar party and Netanyahu's strongest rival, to try to form Israel's next government after the deadlocked 27 October election. Herzog called Eisenkot Saturday evening and will officially task him at a ceremony on…
sources: Israeli President Isaac Herzog's office (statement); Al Jazeera liveblog; CNN; France 24/AFP
fault_line: Netanyahu out -- or a more hawkish PM? Eisenkot wrote the Dahiya Doctrine and lost a son in Gaza: does his government mean peace, or a harder war?
